title: Chapter 298 Soviet Revisionists Retreat
content:
Chapter 298 Soviet Revisionists Retreat

Obviously, the White Horse Knights, who were numerous and had unified actions, became his first target.

"Undead Knights, it's time to prove your strength, for glory!"

"For glory!"

"For glory!"

...

He shouted and led the charge.

Su Xiu saw that most of the undead were rushing towards him, and he also had an ominous premonition in his heart.

"Iron Shield Formation" was launched.

All the White Horse Knights held guns in one hand and took out a one-handed round shield in the other hand, and the formation was closed.

Cavalry rarely equipped with round shields, but at this moment he had to take this defensive charge.

In terms of individual soldier quality, the White Horse Knights could not compare with the Undead Knights, who were above level 50.

Wang Shuo saw the opportunity and immediately reorganized the formation and launched a charge.

Suddenly, Wang Shuo's sword eyebrows were raised and he found that the Undead Knights seemed to have changed.

A closer look showed that they were burning with flames, even the war horses.

It seems that they also launched some kind of secret technique.

The three-headed dog charging in the front also released the "corrosive poison".

Gong Zheng turned into a stone man. His huge body made ordinary war horses unable to bear his weight. Even the flame war horse could not cooperate with Gong Zheng well, so Wang Shuo directly selected a huge three-headed dog for him. At this time, he turned into a god of war, holding two special golden war hammers, invincible.

Ye Tianba was not to be outdone. He wielded a flame gun tightly, which not only protected the three-headed dog well, but also effectively killed the enemy. It can be said that he was both offensive and defensive.

The most eye-catching ones were naturally Ayub and Wang Shuo. They could easily knock down ordinary undead knights. The two cooperated and complemented each other. They joined forces to fight the enemy and directly opened a passage.

As for Good, in order to give full play to his expertise as a cavalry archer and avoid fearless losses, Wang Shuo arranged for him to wander around the edge and be responsible for coordination.

His archery skills were divine, and he could always hit the dominant Undead Knights just right, helping his own people to escape danger and even kill them.

In contrast to Wang Shuo's high momentum, Su Xiu was in a tough battle.

Su Xiu held a sword and joined forces with his two generals, but he was unable to stop Farati's attack. As Farati had fought for many years, he had rich combat experience and much higher combat effectiveness than Su Xiu and others.

If it weren't for his men helping Su Xiu block the fatal blow, Su Xiu might have died here.

After a round of charge, the White Horse Knights were directly crippled.

The main reason was that the White Horse Knights' arrows were "broken" by the Undead Knights.

Seven or eight high-level generals acted as arrows, and the White Horse Knights were simply unable to resist.

After both sides left the battlefield, Su Xiu looked back and saw the bodies of his troops everywhere.

In this round of confrontation, nearly two thousand people were lost.

His lips turned pale, beads of sweat appeared on his forehead, and he was stunned and couldn't believe his eyes.

How could his White Horse Knights be defeated?

How could it be possible? !

In the previous battles, his powerful army was invincible.

But the cold reality dealt him a heavy blow.

A sad expression appeared on his face.

"My lord, let's retreat first!"

"Otherwise, all the men under your command will be killed!"

The casualties were close to half, and the next charge would be at an absolute disadvantage in terms of numbers, and it would be a massacre.

Su Xiu looked unwilling, and looked in the direction of Wang Shuo from a distance, and saw that his losses were much smaller than his own.

Finally, he sighed, put away the lost look on his face, and said decisively: "Retreat."
